jobs.title: Professional Services Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager serves as the primary client liaison on projects and establishes the project plan, project priority, and directs the efforts of personnel involved with all aspects of the project. Their overall goal is twofold: satisfying the customer’s objectives for the project and completing the project on schedule and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

Thoroughly understanding the customer’s business and technical needs
Developing detailed business requirements to be used within a formal statement of work document Managing overall project deliverables and objectives
Acting as primary interface to client business units during all phases of the project
Maintain accurate data in the company’s project management toolset
Provide consistent and timely internal and external project communications
Manage project risks proactively as well as the occurrence of issues
Update resource scheduling weekly in order to produce accurate revenue forecasts
Update the Fixed Price percentage completion data to accurately reflect current and forecasted revenues as required by Leadership
Create, maintain, and store required project documentation in the company’s project repository
Promote Tungsten Automation Corporation’s implementation method, project management best practices and company policies
Utilizes AI-enabled tools (e.g., chatbots, documentation automation, analytics assistants) to improve efficiency, accuracy, and streamline routine tasks while following company AI governance and data privacy standards

About Our Platform

Tungsten Automation's Intelligent Automation software platform helps government agencies transform information-intensive business processes, reduce manual work and errors, minimize costs, and improve customer engagement. We combine Generative AI, Knowledge Management, Intelligent Document Processing, Process Orchestration, mobility and engagement, and analytics to ease implementations and deliver dramatic results that mitigate compliance risk and increase competitiveness, growth and profitability—particularly crucial for highly regulated industries facing complex compliance requirements. No other software vendor offers a platform of complementary technologies integrated into a scalable, manageable software platform, positioning us to grow and dominate the process automation space.

While the job description describes what is anticipated as the requirements of the position, the job requirements are subject to change based upon any changing needs and requirements of the business.

Required Experience

Skills and Knowledge Required

Qualified applicants should have a bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent and 5+ years of project management experience.
Must be able to manage multiple projects simultaneously, have solid project and time-management skills with outstanding verbal and written communications abilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office products (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
Experience in the document management industry is a must.
Familiarity with our Tungsten Automation Corporation Capture product and PMI certification are a plus.
We are looking for a results-oriented self-starter with the ability to effectively deliver projects with minimal management oversight

Preferred Skills

Experience leveraging AI-driven tools to optimize project delivery, enhance decision-making, automate workflows, and ensure ethical, data-governed implementation across enterprise environments.

Your actual base pay within this range will be determined by your work location as well as skills, qualifications, experience, and relevant education/training. The range provided reflects only the base salary for the role and does not include benefits.

jobs.title: People Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The People Operations and Insights team drives project management rigor for the People team and our stakeholders. We empower and enable innovative, connected People products and programs that advance our shared goals and support sustainable growth.

As a Project Manager on our team, you will be responsible for working across our People pillars to champion our delivery across all impacting project/program and portfolios. You will manage projects end-to-end or cross functionally, effectively navigating complex organizational dynamics. You will utilize structured project management methodologies to ensure successful delivery and adoption of high-priority initiatives with our internal team and our users.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

Tackle hard, ambiguous questions with rigor and independence, owning projects from problem definition to final recommendation.
Develop and implement project plans, optimize workflows and ensure all stakeholders are informed and engaged throughout the process.
Monitor project progress, identify potential risks, and proactively implement mitigation strategies to ensure timely and successful project delivery.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including legal, finance, and engineering to identify areas for improvement in processes and controls.
Establish and maintain effective project governance, ensuring that all project activities, decisions, and key milestones comply with standards and best practices.
Prepare materials to present to senior leadership, internal and external stakeholders, and users.
Foster a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and continuous improvement within the People team.

Who you are

Requirements We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these, we encourage you to apply. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Have 7+ years of experience in project management, business operations, strategy, or consulting, with at least 2 years operating within an HR team at a company.
A proven track record of navigating complexity and driving results with a balance of urgency and thoughtfulness.
Experience working cross-functionally with teams like HR, Finance, Legal, Product, Tech and Leadership.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset aimed at informing decision making.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to various stakeholders.
Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, Airtable) and methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, etc.).
Strong cross-functional collaboration abilities and a proven track record of building trust and driving alignment across teams.
Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with change management frameworks (e.g. Prosci ADKAR® Model)
Experience building and deploying enablement and training materials
Experience across HR systems (e.g. HCM, ATS, LMS, CRM)
Experience working with AI tools to increase productivity
Advanced Mac OS and Google suite skills (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides)

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.title: Design Project Manager, Data Centers
jobs.description:
JOB DETAILS:

Position:
Design Project Manager, Data Centers
Status:
Permanent; Full-time
Location:
Remote, must live in the contiguous U.S. or Canada
Closing Date:
Open until filled

ABOUT US:

NGEN Mission Critical is a U.S.-based provider of critical power and cooling infrastructure, serving data centers, AI factories, and utility-scale power generation. We reduce lead times by pairing global manufacturing scalability with a fully integrated American engineering and service platform. In a market defined by equipment scarcity, extended procurement cycles, and heightened regulatory scrutiny, NGEN delivers deployment certainty through disciplined regulatory compliance, coordinated sourcing, and lifecycle accountability. From engineering validation through commissioning and ongoing operational support, NGEN ensures compliance, documentation integrity, and performance continuity in mission-critical environments.

Our team works hard while maintaining a collaborative, respectful, and supportive culture. We are looking for colleagues with a sense of humor, who consider themselves “builders,” and who are excited to make an impact in a future-focused and fast-paced environment.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

We're hiring a Design Project Manager onto NGEN's Data Center Development team. You'll run design projects across the full lifecycle, from early site assessment and due diligence through design development to issue for construction, carrying two to three active projects at a time. You'll be comfortable in the drawings, not just the schedule, and you'll help make the handoff from design into procurement a clean one, because long-lead equipment sets the critical path on every project we touch.

You'll report to our Director of Project Design and work closely with the directors leading construction and procurement, which means you'll see more of a project than the same title would show you at a hyperscaler or a large consultancy. The systems, workflows, and standards are still being written, and you'll help influence them. If you’re energized by fast-moving work, we'd love to meet you!

YOUR MISSION:

• Manage design projects across the full lifecycle, from early site assessment and due diligence through design development to issue for construction
• Run design project schedules, scope and deliverable tracking, and keep consultants and internal stakeholders aligned to them
• Review design drawings alongside our in-house electrical and mechanical experts, coordinating across disciplines and catching errors
• Coordinate the design-to-procurement transition so that equipment specifications, approved submittals and release packages are complete and issued on schedule
• Support procurement on equipment release dates and long-lead equipment schedules, keeping procurement aligned to project sequencing
• Facilitate supplier meetings, escalate delivery risks early, and coordinate delivery logistics with the construction team
• Keep projects moving across the design, procurement and construction handoffs, including when one of the leads is heads-down or out of office
• Maintain project documentation, standards and templates, and improve them as the design function matures
• Communicate status, risks and decisions clearly to customers, consultants and the internal team

YOU'LL WIN US OVER WITH THIS KNOWLEDGE & EXPERIENCE:

• You bring 5+ years of relevant experience across design, engineering, architecture or construction management
• You've taken projects through the full design cycle, from site due diligence to issue for construction, more than once. This one is a hard requirement
• At least one of those cycles was mission-critical work. Other large, complex capital projects count toward the rest
• You come from a civil, structural or architectural background. We have mechanical and electrical covered in-house
• You’re comfortable working within Revit and ACC/Forma
• You read a full set of documents critically and coordinate across disciplines
• You know how to put AI tools like Claude to work for you, and just as importantly, when not to
• You understand data centers and the development process, or you'll do the homework to get there quickly
• Exposure to procurement or equipment planning on large capital projects is a strong asset
• Construction management, commissioning or international project experience are all a plus
• A relevant degree helps but is not required. What you have delivered matters more to us than where you studied

WHO YOU ARE:

• You're comfortable without a lot of direction. Priorities here shift, sometimes by the day, and you're ready to dive in and ask good questions
• You're teachable and you treat that as a strength rather than a gap. You'd rather be brought up to speed on something new than pretend you have already done it
• You catch what doesn't line up. A dimension that disagrees between disciplines, an equipment release that's about to miss the sequence…You see it early enough that it's a quick fix instead of a fire drill
• You'd rather see the whole picture than stay in your lane. Working across design, procurement and construction appeals to you more than a narrow, well-defined scope
• You want your process improvements to stick. On a team this size, the way you decide to run a project becomes the way projects get run
• You're a good time! You roll with the jokes as readily as the punches, and you work hard without taking yourself too seriously

COMPENSATION PACKAGE:

• U.S. base salary: $135,000 - $165,000 USD
• Canada base salary: $130,000 - $160,000 CAD
• The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills
• Annual bonus of up to 25% of your base salary, based on performance
• 401k or RRSP match of up to 5% of your base salary
• Access to health, dental, and vision benefits for you and your dependents
• Three weeks of paid vacation
• Five paid personal days
• Home office set-up support
• Remote working environment with flexibility and autonomy

INTERVIEW PROCESS & TIMELINES:

We're so excited that you are interested in joining our team! Our interview process will look like this:
• Aug 24th – 28th: 3-5 questions will be emailed to shortlisted candidates, confirming some basic information about you and why you're interested in this position (estimated time commitment 10-15 minutes)
• Aug 31st – Sep 4th: 30-minute virtual meeting with our recruitment team so that we can learn more about your career path so far, and you have a chance to ask us any questions that you have
• Sep 8th – 11th: A 1-hour meeting with the Director of Project Design and Head of People & Culture
• Sep 14th – 18th: Reference checks and an employment offer extended

We will do our best to follow the timelines outlined, and we will let you know if timelines shift!

HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI IN RECRUITMENT:

We believe in real humans hiring real humans.

• To keep things organized and thoughtful, NGEN uses AI-assisted tools for note taking during interviews. That said, every conversation, evaluation, and hiring decision is made by real people on our team (including initial resume screening). The only automated (not AI-augmented, just automated) step in our process is at the initial screening question stage when you first apply for the role.
• We are so excited to meet you and hear about all the incredible experiences and expertise you have built throughout your career. It's very important to us that we hear about those experiences and pieces of expertise in your own words – we prefer messy and authentic to polished with no depth. We mention this because we know how tight the labor market is and why some candidates may feel compelled to use an AI companion tool to help them answer questions live in interviews. Please be aware that if we suspect that you are using a tool like this, we will stop the interview and remove your application from consideration.
We do believe in using AI to support our everyday work in areas that we've identified as low value or low energy – we routinely use tools like Claude, Zapier, Fireflies.ai, and Grammarly. Bringing on a new teammate is very important to us, so this effort falls into neither of those categories of “low value” or “low energy”.

We will show up for you in this recruitment process! In turn, please show up (as you!) for us. We can't wait to meet you!

HOW TO APPLY:

If this role sounds like it's right up your alley, but you're worried about missing a few of the qualifications, please reach out with your interest anyway. We value the unique skill sets, experiences, and pathways that people take in their careers, and are aware that non-traditional routes are sometimes overlooked. We make hiring decisions based on skill, and we're excited to hear what you will bring to our team!
• This is a permanent, full-time position and a fully remote role with some travel required
• We are not in a position to sponsor visa applications of any kind. As a result, only candidates who are currently legally entitled to work in the USA and/or Canada will be considered for this role
• This position will typically work Monday to Friday within the normal business hours of the region in which the successful candidate lives. As a member of a globally remote team, some meetings outside of normal business hours will be required for this role

Please submit a resume and cover letter to careers@ngen-mc.com with the subject ‘ Design Project Manager Application
.’ We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We're a small, high-leverage team that bridges strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

Stripe's Total Rewards programs span compensation, benefits, equity, internal mobility/immigration, and mergers and acquisitions (M&A), each with cross-functional dependencies, regulatory stakes, and direct impact on the Stripes they affect. Delivering these programs well takes a Project Manager who develops real subject matter depth, engages with pillar leads as a strategic partner, and brings structure to decisions that aren't always clear-cut.

We're hiring a Project Manager to own high-priority Total Rewards projects and programs end to end. You'll work closely with our Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A pillars, building expertise in how these programs work and what it takes to land them well. Some programs have established playbooks you'll sharpen; others are less defined and will need you to help shape the approach before you execute it. Across all of them, you'll identify dependencies early, proactively surface and mitigate risks, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving toward clear outcomes. This is a high-leverage individual contributor role for someone who brings both rigor and judgment to every project they own.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end project management for high-profile cyclical and transformational Total Rewards projects, from intake and scoping through go-live and handoff to program owners
Advise and embed with project teams across the Total Rewards and People portfolio, raising the quality bar and building PM capability across the extended team, not just doing the work yourself
Build subject matter expertise across Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A — becoming a reliable strategic thought partner to pillar teams on program decisions, not just a tracker of status
Build, automate, and continuously improve the infrastructure that makes program management repeatable and scalable: intake frameworks, project plan templates, SOPs, playbooks, and handoff checklists for common program types
Leverage AI tools in your daily work and the team's workflows, using them to accelerate synthesis, drafting, stakeholder communications, and documentation, and actively identifying new opportunities to work faster and better
Drive cross-functional alignment across People and key partner functions (Legal, Finance, Corporate Technology, and others), creating shared visibility into priorities, dependencies, and blockers
Tackle complex, ambiguous program questions with rigor and independence, owning work from problem definition through final recommendation — including defining the approach, monitoring progress, identifying risks early, and putting mitigation in place before issues land
Surface patterns and gaps across the program portfolio, translating observations into structured analysis and recommendations for People leadership

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of People project, program, or operations management experience, including at least 3 years driving multi-stakeholder, cross-functional programs end to end, ideally at a scaling or global company
A track record of building from scratch: you've created processes, playbooks, or program infrastructure where none existed before, not just improved what was already in place
Excellent written communication: you can produce an executive update, a stakeholder decision memo, and a practitioner playbook with equal fluency
Strong stakeholder management across senior cross-functional partners: you drive results with a balance of urgency and thoughtfulness, and know when to push, when to align, and when to escalate
AI expertise: you default to AI tools for synthesis, drafting, analysis, and communications, and you proactively design workflows that help the team move faster and operate at scale.
Analytical fluency: you can work with data to build a credible narrative, identify patterns across a program portfolio, and make recommendations grounded in evidence
A users-first mindset: you obsess over the Stripe employee experience and the operator experience, not just the project/program artifacts

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with change management frameworks (such as Prosci ADKAR) and judgment about when to apply structured change management vs. lighter-touch approaches
Experience building and deploying enablement materials or training resources for cross-functional teams
Experience in Total Rewards, People Operations, or an adjacent HR domain
Familiarity with PM and collaboration tools (Asana, Jira, or similar)
Familiarity with Total Rewards or HR systems (such as Workday, equity administration platforms, or benefits administration tools)
PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, or comparable structured-program training

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Axel Group is currently seeking a Project Manager to join our client’s team in the Orlando, FL area. Our client partners with leading contractors and builders across the commercial, institutional, healthcare, and industrial sectors, providing everything from tools and safety products to custom-fabricated strut grids, pipe hangers, and pre-engineered support systems. With a strong reputation, national footprint, and long-standing relationships throughout the construction industry, the company continues to grow its presence in key markets including healthcare, data centers, infrastructure, and commercial development.

The Project Manager role is a hands-on, high-ownership position focused on managing projects from award through installation and contract closeout. This individual will work closely with general contractors, construction managers, field crews, vendors, customers, and internal leadership to coordinate project requirements, maintain schedules, address issues, and ensure work is completed successfully. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to take ownership of multiple projects while serving as a key point of contact throughout the project lifecycle.

While the position is primarily focused on Project Management, there is also a light estimating and preconstruction component. This includes reviewing drawings and specifications, assisting with material takeoffs, gathering pricing, reviewing project scopes, and supporting estimates and change orders. The ideal candidate does not need to be a career estimator, but should be comfortable reading construction documents, understanding project scope, and working with both field and office teams.

This position offers the opportunity to join a stable, privately held organization with 40+ years of industry experience, a national footprint, and significant resources behind its continued growth. You’ll work on a diverse range of projects while building relationships with some of the industry’s leading contractors and construction professionals. The company provides a competitive compensation package, full benefits including medical, dental, vision, PTO, and 401(k), along with strong opportunities for professional development and long-term career advancement.

Job Duties & Responsibilities

Manage multiple construction projects from initial kickoff through installation and final contract closeout.
Take ownership of project execution, ensuring work progresses according to plans, specifications, schedules, budgets, and contractual requirements.
Coordinate project schedules, materials, field installation crews, contractors, vendors, customers, and internal teams.
Serve as a primary point of contact for customers, general contractors, construction managers, and other project stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Review construction drawings, specifications, submittals, and contract documents to understand project scope and requirements.
Coordinate with field teams and installation crews to ensure projects are properly executed and completed in accordance with project requirements and quality standards.
Monitor project progress, materials, costs, schedules, and overall execution while proactively identifying potential issues.
Troubleshoot project challenges and work with internal and external teams to resolve issues that may impact schedule, cost, quality, or customer satisfaction.
Maintain regular communication with customers, contractors, vendors, and internal leadership regarding project status, priorities, and next steps.
Assist with light estimating, material takeoffs, pricing, and proposal development for new and existing project opportunities.
Review project scopes and assist with obtaining material, fabrication, and subcontractor pricing as needed.
Support the preparation and management of change orders, project documentation, billings, and contract closeout.
Coordinate with the sales team and internal leadership on new opportunities and ongoing customer relationships.
Visit active jobsites throughout the assigned regional territory to support project execution, customer needs, and field teams.
Maintain organized project records and ensure required documentation is accurate and submitted in a timely manner.
Work independently while managing multiple projects and priorities across different stages of construction.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Strong understanding of construction processes and project management principles.
Ability to read, interpret, and work from construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents.
Ability to understand project scope and identify material, labor, and installation requirements.
Basic estimating and quantity takeoff experience preferred; this is a Project Management-focused position with a light estimating component.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills when working with customers, contractors, field teams, vendors, and internal personnel.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate issues and take ownership of finding solutions.
Comfortable working in both office and field environments and regularly visiting active construction sites.
Ability to work independently and make decisions while keeping customers and internal leadership informed.
Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and sense of urgency.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and general project management software; familiarity with AutoCAD, BIM, or construction-related software is a plus.

Education & Experience Requirements

3+ years of experience in construction project management, project coordination, or a related construction role preferred.
Construction-related degree or technical education preferred, but equivalent industry experience will be considered.
Experience managing projects from kickoff through installation and closeout is highly preferred.
Experience working with general contractors, construction managers, subcontractors, vendors, or field installation teams preferred.
Ability to read and interpret construction plans, specifications, and project documentation.
Previous estimating, takeoff, or preconstruction experience is a plus but not the primary focus of the position.
Ability and willingness to travel throughout the assigned regional territory to support active projects and customers.
Valid driver's license and ability to travel between project locations as needed.

Compensation & Benefits

Our client offers a competitive compensation package along with a strong benefits program, including:
Car allowance
Performance-based incentive opportunities
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid time off and company holidays
Ongoing training and professional development
Career advancement opportunities
Long-term career stability with an established organization

Why Join Our Client

Join a privately held organization with 40+ years of proven success and a strong reputation within the construction industry.
Be part of a company with a national footprint and $600M+ in annual revenue, providing the resources and stability of a large organization while maintaining a strong, relationship-driven culture.
Work alongside a team with long-standing relationships with leading contractors, builders, and construction professionals across the country.
Gain exposure to projects across healthcare, data centers, infrastructure upgrades, commercial development, and other major construction markets.
Take meaningful ownership of projects from initial kickoff through installation and final closeout rather than being limited to one portion of the project lifecycle.
Build relationships directly with customers, contractors, construction managers, vendors, and field teams.
Join a role that combines project management, customer interaction, field coordination, problem-solving, and light estimating.
Work in a position offering significant autonomy and the ability to make an impact on day-to-day project execution.
Join an organization experiencing continued growth with opportunities to take on additional responsibility and advance your career over the long term.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

About You:

We are looking for someone who combines a strong commercial mindset, relationship-building abilities, and analytical thinking, with a proactive approach to developing partnerships and growing the business.

3+ years of experience in project management, operations, consulting, business development, partnerships, or similar roles (this role is not primarily suited for traditional event planners)
English on a native level, with excellent communication skills

Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and drive multiple workstreams to successful completion.
Resilient and results-driven, able to perform under pressure, take ownership, and manage several high-impact projects in parallel.

Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to use data to guide decision-making
Highly solution-oriented, able to identify challenges and develop practical strategies to resolve them

You will join a team of highly effective, motivated, and entrepreneurial professionals who move fast, take ownership, and get things done. Title: Project Manager

Company:
Rethink Electric
Location:
Wood Dale, IL
Type:
Full-Time, In-Office
Compensation:
$40–$49/hour + Discretionary Bonus + Comprehensive Benefits

About Rethink

Rethink Electric is a leading commercial and industrial solar electrical contractor with more than 15 years of experience and more than 1,000 projects installed. We specialize in the construction and installation of commercial and industrial solar projects across the United States, including rooftop and ground-mount systems.

Rethink partners with solar developers, EPCs, building owners and other project stakeholders to safely and efficiently construct high-quality solar energy systems.

Position Overview

Rethink Electric is seeking an experienced Project Manager – Solar EPC Construction to lead the execution and delivery of commercial and industrial solar projects throughout the United States.
This is a construction-focused EPC Project Manager position, not an owner/developer project management role. The Project Manager will be responsible for managing projects from Notice to Proceed (NTP) and mobilization through construction, commissioning, Substantial Completion and final turnover to the customer/O&M team.

The Project Manager will serve as the primary point of coordination between Rethink's field operations, engineering, procurement, subcontractors, customers and other project stakeholders. The successful candidate will be accountable for delivering projects safely, on schedule, within budget, in accordance with contract requirements, and to Rethink's quality standards.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on construction project manager who understands how solar projects are actually built and can effectively manage the people, materials, schedule, costs, contracts and issues required to successfully execute a project.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Construction Management

Lead the execution of commercial and industrial rooftop and ground-mount solar projects from NTP through final completion.
Develop and maintain project execution plans and coordinate project mobilization.
Establish clear project objectives, responsibilities, milestones and deliverables for internal teams and subcontractors.
Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction and commissioning activities to ensure successful project execution.
Work closely with the Superintendent, Foremen and field crews to identify and resolve construction issues.
Monitor daily and weekly construction progress and take corrective action when performance does not meet the project plan.
Develop and implement recovery plans when projects fall behind schedule.
Ensure construction activities are performed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements and applicable codes.

Schedule Management

Develop, maintain and actively manage the project baseline schedule.
Establish and manage critical path activities and contractual milestones.
Develop and maintain three-week and other short-term look-ahead schedules as required.
Track project progress against planned production and milestone dates.
Identify schedule risks and develop mitigation and recovery strategies.
Coordinate schedule impacts associated with engineering, permitting, procurement, material deliveries, weather, subcontractors and customer requirements.
Communicate schedule status and potential delays to project leadership and customers in a timely manner.

Subcontractor & Field Team Management

Manage and coordinate subcontractors throughout project execution.
Establish clear expectations for schedule, production, quality, safety, documentation and contract compliance.
Monitor subcontractor performance and address deficiencies promptly.
Review subcontractor schedules, manpower levels and productivity.
Coordinate with field leadership to ensure adequate manpower, equipment and materials are available to maintain the project schedule.
Support subcontractor procurement, scope alignment, negotiations and performance management.

Procurement & Material Management

Coordinate project procurement activities with the estimating, procurement and operations teams.
Track major equipment and material procurement from purchase through delivery to the project site.
Identify long-lead items and material risks that could impact the construction schedule.
Coordinate material deliveries, site logistics and equipment requirements.
Resolve material shortages, damaged materials, incorrect deliveries and other procurement issues that affect project execution.

Cost & Financial Management

Manage project budgets and monitor actual and committed costs against the approved project budget.
Maintain accurate project cost forecasts and identify potential cost exposures.
Review subcontractor invoices, purchase orders and project expenditures.
Identify cost impacts associated with changes, delays, productivity issues and unforeseen conditions.
Work with project leadership to develop and implement cost-control measures.
Support monthly project forecasting and financial reporting.

Contract & Change Management

Manage project execution in accordance with the EPC contract, subcontract agreements, drawings, specifications and other contractual requirements.
Identify changes in scope and document potential cost and schedule impacts.
Prepare and support change order requests, claims and other contractual correspondence.
Ensure required notices are issued in accordance with contractual requirements.
Maintain appropriate documentation to protect Rethink's contractual position.
Monitor subcontractor compliance with contractual obligations.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Serve as a primary point of contact for the customer during construction.
Lead or participate in weekly construction and project status meetings.
Provide accurate project status updates, including schedule, cost, progress, risks, issues and recovery actions.
Maintain professional relationships with customers, subcontractors, consultants, utilities, AHJs and other project stakeholders.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

Support Rethink's safety culture and ensure project activities are performed in accordance with company safety requirements and project-specific requirements.
Coordinate quality control activities and ensure work complies with approved plans, specifications and applicable codes.

Commissioning, Completion & Turnover

Coordinate construction completion activities with commissioning and operations teams.
Support system energization, testing and commissioning activities.
Manage punch-list development and completion. .

Project Documentation & Reporting

Maintain accurate project records within Procore and other company systems.
Manage RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes, daily reports, schedules, change documentation and other project records.
Prepare weekly and monthly project reports.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, Architecture or a related field preferred; equivalent construction experience will be considered.
5+ years of construction project management experience, preferably with commercial/industrial electrical, renewable energy or solar EPC projects.
Demonstrated experience managing construction projects from mobilization through completion and turnover.
Commercial or industrial solar construction experience strongly preferred.
Experience managing subcontractors and field construction teams.
Strong understanding of construction scheduling, project controls, procurement and cost management.
Experience with contract administration, change orders and subcontractor management.
Proficiency with Procore, Microsoft Project, Primavera P6 or similar construction/project management software.
Strong Excel skills and the ability to analyze project cost and schedule information.
Ability to read and understand construction drawings, specifications, contracts and project schedules.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced construction environment.
Willingness to travel to project sites as required.
Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving project issues.

Compensation & Benefits

Full-time position with competitive compensation commensurate with experience.

Discretionary bonus opportunities.
401(k) employer match.
Health, vision and dental benefits.
Paid time off, including company holidays.
Opportunity for advancement within a growing renewable energy construction company.

jobs.description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

The Opportunity

We're doing an AI-first engineering rebuild for a company that already has an audience of 100M+ people. This is a zero-to-one build with no legacy constraints, multiple workstreams running in parallel, and a hard launch deadline. You're not here to run status meetings. You're here to make sure nothing falls through the cracks across internal engineering teams, external development partners, and a product that millions of people will use the day it ships.

The Product

You'll be the execution backbone of the Beast membership app, coordinating across Beast's internal engineering teams, our game development partners, and multiple vendors, ensuring every workstream is tightly aligned, every handoff is clean, and every risk is surfaced and resolved before it becomes a blocker. That means:

A complex multi-vendor, multi-team program where alignment gaps and handoff failures directly threaten the launch timeline.
Integration milestones that require meticulous tracking, structured check-ins, and proactive escalation when things slip.
A fast-moving engineering org that needs someone who can bring rigor without slowing down velocity.

What You'll Do

Own the program plan end to end across internal teams and external partners, covering milestones, dependencies, risks, and blockers.
Drive structured weekly check-ins with all key leads, ensuring alignment on integration milestones and surfacing issues early enough to course correct.
Enforce handoff standards so nothing ships without the receiving team being fully ready, including documentation, onboarding sessions, and acceptance criteria locked before any handoff closes.
Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, product, and vendor partners, translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders and escalating to exec leadership when needed.
Build and maintain a "can't fail" execution culture by proactively identifying risks, owning follow-through, and holding teams accountable without micromanaging.

Who You Are

Execution-Obsessed: You run tight programs. You know the difference between a status update and actually moving something forward, and you default to the latter.
Multi-Vendor Experience: You've managed programs involving external development partners or contractors alongside internal engineering teams, and you know how to hold vendors accountable without burning the relationship.
Technical Depth: You're comfortable going deep enough to understand engineering dependencies, integration risks, and technical handoff requirements. You don't need to write the code, but you need to know when something isn't right.
Clear Communicator: You can run a crisp leadership sync, write a structured escalation memo, and tell a VP exactly what's at risk and what needs to happen, all in the same day.
Startup Ready: You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and know how to build a process that enables velocity rather than slowing it down.

5+ years of TPM or program management experience in a technical environment, with at least 2 years managing programs involving external vendors or development partners. Bonus points for experience in consumer app development, media or entertainment technology, or managing game SDK or mobile framework integrations.

Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA)

Are you ready to shape a brighter future?

In the Motion Systems Group and Hydraulic Valve Systems Division, we play a pivotal role in applications that change our world. We are in almost everything that moves. We have an exciting opening for a Program Manager.

This position manages and is accountable for the contract performance for divisional programs or a set of related projects to achieve programmatic business objectives throughout the program lifecycle. Serves as the customer advocate and ensures effective program management processes, schedule, cost, resources, risk, project change management, and commitments to customers are met. Manage a program or combination of programs of broad scope and complexity. Programs typically are for a large or a diverse set of customers, market segment(s)or product line(s). Program scope is generally evaluated based on non-recurring engineering cost of the program(s).

Your Main Responsibilities

Ensures customer requirements are met and are in the best interests of Parker by creating the program charter, baseline plan, and other program management components. Ensures that the cost basis and/or pricing is correct by evaluating resource requirements and performing risk analyses. As described by AGS PRM-01(Program Management Policy).
Responsible for integrated program schedules, data integration, tracking of financial and quality performance, and implementation of corrective actions covering all areas of program responsibility. Addresses critical issues on complex programs and leads the team to develop action plans to improve performance.
Leads the development of program plans covering mature and new product development programs. Participates in program planning efforts; directs all phases of programs throughout the program lifecycle.
Serves as the primary point of contact to the programâ€™s customer and is responsible for the negotiation of contract changes related to scope management.
Organizes and leads programs by defining and identifying required expertise; provides feedback on contribution and performance to team members and their direct manager if in a matrix role. Responsible for plans, budgets, staffing, training, and development of direct staff.

Bachelors degree (BS/BA) in Engineering, Sciences, Business or a related field; and prior program or significant project management experience. PMP certification required, typically within 6 months of assignment; advanced degree (MS/MBA) and additional certifications (e.g. PgMP, PMI-RMP) preferred.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. As a Technical Program Manager in the Risk and Compliance space, you'll play a key role across engineering, product, and strategy to drive programs that span across the Risk organization and Stripe. Define and produce high-quality written proposals, communications and documentation.
Leverage data and acquired knowledge to drive strategic decisions at an engineering leadership level.

jobs.description:
FieldAI’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field.

About the Role

Our Perception & AI/ML organization runs several research and engineering programs at once, and they converge on the same robots in the same customer deployments. Priorities shift — that is the nature of the work — and when they do, someone needs to know what the shift costs, who it affects, and what we tell the customer.

That is this role. You will be the connective layer between what customers need, what the company has committed to, and what the research and engineering teams are actually building. You will report directly to the VP leading Perception & AI/ML and work closely with the broader leadership team.

This is not a process-administration job. You will be expected to hold an accurate picture of a large, fast-moving technical organization, form your own view of what is at risk, and say so early — including when that is unwelcome.

What You'll Do

Own the program-level picture across concurrent research and engineering workstreams: what is in flight, who owns it, what is due, and what is slipping.

Translate customer and product requirements into prioritized internal work, and keep delivery timelines honest against what has been committed externally.

Serve as a program-level point of contact for customer deployments — carrying their needs inward, and carrying status, tradeoffs, and timelines back out.

Surface risks and blockers before they become schedule problems, and drive them to resolution across teams.

Run the re-prioritization conversations when commitments change: what continues, what pauses, what gets reassigned, and who needs to hear about it.

Build reporting and tracking that engineers will actually maintain — enough signal to steer by, light enough to survive a fast quarter.

Partner with senior technical leads and the leadership team without directing the technical approach.

What You Have

4–7 years as a Technical Program Manager or equivalent, supporting AI/ML or data-driven engineering teams.

Experience across the AI/ML lifecycle — data collection and labeling, model training, evaluation, and deployment.

Experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders, turning their needs into internal priorities and timelines.

A demonstrated track record of bringing structure to ambiguous, fast-moving technical programs.

Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, or related), or equivalent practical experience.

What Sets You Apart

Experience in autonomous vehicles, robotics, drones, embedded systems, or another autonomy domain.

Experience supporting AI/ML programs at scale inside a larger technology organization — recommendations, ranking, ads, or consumer AI.

Background in data operations, data security, or systems integration.

Experience supporting field operations or production customer deployments.

Comfort acting as a trusted technical point of contact for customers in mission-critical deployments.

Fluency with Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace — and the judgment to keep tooling minimal.

PMP, Certified Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.

Startup or high-growth experience, with a strong bias toward ownership and urgency.

Why Join FieldAI in Irvine?

In Irvine, you will work where the robots are. Our local team builds and tests systems on real hardware with real sensors, then ships them to operate in unstructured, previously unknown environments around the world. We are solving one of robotics’ hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.

You will collaborate with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring deep experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, along with a track record of field deployments and strong performance in DARPA challenge segments.

Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution

We are looking for builders who want their work to leave the whiteboard and show up on robots. If you enjoy tackling tough, uncharted questions and working across disciplines, you will find your people here. Our teams span AI, software, robotics engineering, product, field deployment, and technical communication, all focused on shipping systems that perform in the real world.

Our headquarters is in Irvine, and we partner closely with teams there as well as colleagues across the US and around the world. Join us in Southern California and help define what dependable, field-ready autonomy looks like.

We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We evaluate candidates and employees based on merit, qualifications, and performance, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager – Launch Site Quality & Production Operations
jobs.description:
As a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) of Launch Site Quality, you will establish the foundational blueprint for launch site mission assurance. This is a pioneering role focused on assisting and leading multi-faceted quality activities from the ground up. You will actively drive the build, infrastructure activation, and implementation of various rocket launch sites. As production scales, you will transition to managing the daily technical operations and quality execution of live vehicle launch campaigns. You will serve as a cross-functional bridge, partnering with launch operations, engineering, and regulatory bodies to transition complex aerospace infrastructure from construction into a reliable, certified production state.

Position Details

Location: Vandenberg, CA launch sites or Austin, TX metro area (Relocation Assistance available).
Travel Expectation: Approximately 75% initially. This will fluctuate depending on launch status and new site standups. Major locations include Southern California, Virginia, and potential sites.
Classification: Full-time, Exempt.

Key Responsibilities

Site Build, Implementation & Activation

Partner closely with launch engineering teams to establish quality baselines, build pipelines, and infrastructure at brand-new launch sites. Architect and implement the quality management system (QMS) framework directly at the launch site to prepare facilities for successful AS9100 certification. Act as a technical trailblazer to define, document, and scale Program Quality roles, responsibilities, and procedural requirements across emerging test stands and integration facilities.
Transition completed sites into active production states, leading tactical, hands-on quality management tasks at the launch pad. Oversee hardware and vehicle integration, final pad closeouts, fueling system verification, and post-flight quality data reviews. Lead rigorous Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) processes to resolve live production non-conformances and ensure launch schedule reliability.
Author, implement, and enforce the quality procedures, hazard analyses, and verification methods necessary to satisfy strict range safety protocols. Maintain rigorous alignment with federal and commercial requirements, ensuring compliance frameworks meet or exceed AFSPCMAN 91-110, RCC 319, or FAA Part 450 regulations.

Required Qualifications

Experience: Minimum 3+ years in aerospace mission assurance. A significant portion must be dedicated to active launch site operations, test environments, or flightline campaigns. Included is Direct technical experience writing or implementing procedures to clear Range Safety requirements.
Proven track record building, implementing, or scaling a QMS framework from the ground up to meet AS9100 standards. Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline, OR 7+ years of verified, elite-level launch site quality experience in lieu of a degree.

Preferred Qualifications

Pioneering Track Record: Experience acting as a foundational quality engineer or "first-hire" during an early-stage commercial launch vehicle campaign with strong hands-on understanding of complex aerospace hardware systems, including fluids (cryogenics, high-pressure gas), ordnance handling, and flight avionics integration.

jobs.description:
Overview

Who we are

Collaborative. Respectful. A place to dream and do. These are just a few words that describe what life is like at Toyota. As one of the world’s most admired brands, Toyota is growing and leading the future of mobility through innovative, high-quality solutions designed to enhance lives and delight those we serve. We’re looking for talented team members who want to Dream. Do. Grow. with us.

An important part of the Toyota family is Toyota Financial Services (TFS), the finance and insurance brand for Toyota and Lexus in North America. While TFS is a separate business entity, it is an essential part of this world-changing company- delivering on Toyota's vision to move people beyond what's possible. At TFS, you will help create best-in-class customer experience in an innovative, collaborative environment.

Toyota does not offer support or sponsorship of job applicants for employment-based visas or any other work authorization for this role now or in the future. You must have the right to work in the United States and not require Toyota support or sponsorship for immigration-related employment (e.g., H-1B, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, TN, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, ‘job flexibility benefits’ [also known as I-140 or Adjustment of Status portability], etc.) now or in the future. You should not apply for this role if you will require Toyota to assist with immigration support or sponsorship now or in the future.

Who We’re Looking For

Toyota’s Cyber Security Department is looking for a passionate and highly motivated Cyber Security Program Manager.

As the Cyber Security Program Manager, Cyber Security, you will serve as a strategic leader accountable for both the hands-on delivery of complex cybersecurity initiatives and the enterprise-level orchestration of multiple interrelated programs. This role is responsible for ensuring cybersecurity efforts are aligned to business strategy, risk priorities, compliance obligations, and long-term technology roadmaps.

You will lead cross-functional planning and execution across security engineering, architecture, infrastructure, risk, compliance, release management, vendors, procurement, and business stakeholders. In addition to owning day-to-day delivery execution, you will establish governance, drive prioritization, remove barriers, and influence decisions that impact the cybersecurity portfolio across the enterprise.

This role requires deep program management capability, strong cybersecurity domain knowledge, excellent stakeholder leadership, and the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy across complex and ambiguous environments. You are expected to balance tactical execution with strategic leadership, ensuring both immediate delivery commitments and long-term program outcomes are achieved.

What You’ll Be Doing

These are accountabilities you are solely responsible for and will execute daily/weekly:

Project and Program Delivery Execution: Lead the full delivery lifecycle for complex cybersecurity initiatives, including planning, execution, dependency management, milestone tracking, and delivery oversight across multiple workstreams. Ensure committed objectives, timelines, and quality standards are met.
Agile Cadence and Delivery Management: Drive the daily project cadence, including stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Ensure work is prioritized appropriately, delivery progress is transparent, and impediments are escalated and resolved quickly.
Risk, Issue, and Dependency Management: Proactively identify, document, assess, and manage risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies using structured frameworks such as RAID logs. Anticipate bottlenecks, implement corrective actions, and maintain delivery momentum across competing priorities.
Budget and Financial Management: Own and manage project and program budgets across all cost categories, including labor, technology, professional services, and vendor spend. Monitor actuals versus forecast, identify variances, and take corrective action to maintain financial alignment.
Executive and Stakeholder Reporting: Provide clear, timely reporting to executive, management, and team-level stakeholders on scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, and decisions. Maintain dashboards, scorecards, and program communications that support informed decision-making.
Release, Change, and Deployment Coordination: Partner with Release Management and other delivery teams to ensure cybersecurity deliverables move through release and change governance processes successfully. Confirm readiness, manage dependencies, and ensure all artifacts and approvals are aligned with enterprise controls.
Compliance and Governance Oversight: Ensure cybersecurity initiatives are delivered in alignment with applicable regulations, standards, and internal policies such as NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and enterprise control requirements. Partner with GRC, compliance, and risk teams to embed security obligations into execution.
Vendor and Procurement Management: Manage third-party vendors and service providers to ensure contracted work is delivered on time, within scope, and to quality expectations. Support vendor selection, SOW development, milestone tracking, and performance reviews.
Intake Prioritization and Portfolio Coordination: Own the cybersecurity intake process by triaging, categorizing, and prioritizing incoming requests. Ensuring work is aligned to business objectives, strategically sequenced, and appropriately resourced.

Shared Responsibilities

These are areas where you actively participate and drive execution in partnership with other teams or leadership:

Strategic Roadmap Alignment: Partner with leaders across cybersecurity, technology, and business functions to maintain and evolve the cybersecurity product and project roadmap in alignment with enterprise priorities.
Cross-Functional Program Leadership: Lead multiple interdependent cybersecurity initiatives across engineering, architecture, operations, compliance, legal, procurement, and business teams to ensure alignment and execution against shared goals.
Governance and Decision Forums: Establish and operate program governance routines, escalation paths, dependency reviews, and decision-making forums to keep work moving and resolve cross-functional blockers.
Resource and Priority Tradeoff Management: Collaborate with senior stakeholders to evaluate competing demands, resource constraints, sequencing options, and delivery tradeoffs. Provide recommendations that balance business value, risk reduction, and feasibility.
Organizational Alignment: Influence senior leaders and partners across the enterprise to drive clarity, commitment, and accountability for cybersecurity outcomes.

Periodic Responsibilities

These are areas you facilitate on a recurring or as-needed basis to support broader organizational maturity:

Process Improvement and Delivery Maturity: Identify and implement improvements to planning, execution, governance, and reporting processes that increase predictability, transparency, and efficiency across cybersecurity programs.
Coaching and Mentorship: Serve as a subject matter resource to project and program teams, sharing best practices and mentoring others on delivery methodology, risk management, and execution discipline.
Tooling and Data Integrity: Use tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Power BI, and related platforms to manage plans, track progress, and maintain accurate program data and reporting.
Strategic Influence: Influence cybersecurity priorities, sequencing, and long-term planning by surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and investment implications to senior leadership.
Executive Escalation Management: Prepare clear recommendations and decision support materials for senior stakeholders when issues, conflicts, or tradeoffs require executive attention.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of progressive experience in project or program management, including extensive experience in complex, cross-functional environments.
5+ years of experience leading cybersecurity, IT, or technology initiatives through the software development lifecycle.
Strong experience managing multiple concurrent projects or programs with interdependent deliverables, competing priorities, and executive stakeholders.
Proven ability to lead planning, execution, budgeting, risk management, and governance for complex technology initiatives.
Demonstrated success influencing without direct authority and partnering effectively with senior leaders.
Excellent communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong judgment and ability to operate independently in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

Added bonus if you have

Master’s degree in a related field such as cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, or information technology.
Experience leading enterprise cybersecurity programs in regulated industries such as financial services, banking, insurance, or automotive.
Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or PMP.
Experience building or improving cybersecurity operating models, governance mechanisms, or portfolio processes.
Familiarity with cloud security, identity and access management, vulnerability management, third-party risk, or security architecture programs.

What We’ll Bring

During your interview process, our team can fill you in on all the details of our industry-leading benefits and career development opportunities. A few highlights include:

A work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect
Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career, as well as tuition reimbursement
Team Member Vehicle Purchase Discount
Toyota Team Member Lease Vehicle Program (if applicable)
Comprehensive health care and wellness plans for your entire family
Toyota 401(k) Savings Plan featuring a company match, as well as an annual retirement contribution from Toyota regardless of whether you contribute (if applicable)
Paid holidays and paid time off
Referral services related to prenatal services, adoption, childcare, schools and more
Tax Advantaged Accounts (Health Savings Account, Health Care FSA, Dependent Care FSA)
Relocation assistance (if applicable)

Belonging at Toyota

Our success begins and ends with our people. We embrace all perspectives and value unique human experiences. Respect for all is our North Star.

Applicants for our positions are considered without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, religion, military or veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law.
