Amentum is seeking an experienced Project Manager
(SME) to support Combatant Command Operations in the Information Environment (OIE) under the Apollo program. The Apollo Solutions Architect Team (ASAT) is a cross-functional enterprise team that drives innovation, standardization, and integration across all Apollo Task Order services. ASAT serves as Apollo’s dedicated SME cell, delivering scalable support to Combatant Commands through advanced solution design, operational integration, training, analysis, and modernization. Centrally based in Tampa, the ASAT continuously develops and deploys new tools, workflows, and TTPs to outpace adversaries and strengthen Combatant Command information advantage.

As a member of ASAT, the selected candidate will manage integrated capability-development projects that improve how Apollo plans, fields, adopts, sustains, and assesses OIE/IW capabilities across Combatant Commands and mission partners. This role applies a holistic capability-lines-of-development approach — including doctrine/TTPs, organization, training, materiel/tools, leadership, personnel, facilities, policy, and process integration — to ensure new capabilities are operationally relevant, adoptable, measurable, scalable, and aligned with Government objectives. The Project Manager (SME) will coordinate cross-functional teams, manage Integrated Project Plans, track risks and dependencies, synchronize stakeholder inputs, and drive implementation of enterprise solutions that improve planning, operations, assessment, mission-enabling services, and decision support.

As a Project Manager (SME), you will:

Serve as a senior member of the Apollo Solution Architect Team (ASAT), supporting enterprise-level capability development, modernization, and integration across all Apollo Task Order services.
Manage cross-functional capability-development projects using a holistic lines-of-development approach that considers doctrine/TTPs, organization, training, materiel/tools, leadership, personnel, facilities, policy, processes, data, and sustainment requirements.
Lead development, coordination, execution, and update of Integrated Project Plans (IPPs), including project objectives, milestones, staffing/resource requirements, risks, dependencies, deliverables, implementation schedules, and ROI considerations.
Translate Combatant Command and mission-partner operational needs into executable project plans, implementation roadmaps, decision-support products, and capability-integration strategies.
Coordinate across ASAT Solutions Managers, Solutions Designers, Innovation SMEs, Plans/Ops SMEs, Assessment SMEs, Data/AI SMEs, Knowledge Managers, Training/Adoption SMEs, and operational stakeholders to ensure capability solutions are fully integrated and operationally executable.
Support capability gap analysis, requirements decomposition, stakeholder analysis, implementation planning, and sustainment planning for OIE/IW tools, workflows, data architectures, assessment methods, planning processes, and operational support capabilities.
Ensure new or improved capabilities are aligned with Apollo objectives, Task Order requirements, CCMD campaign priorities, joint planning processes, and Government-directed operational timelines.
Develop project management artifacts, including project charters, implementation plans, milestone schedules, risk registers, decision logs, action trackers, project briefs, capability roadmaps, and executive-level status updates.
Identify risks, interdependencies, constraints, and mitigation actions affecting capability implementation, including security, classification, data-access, staffing, stakeholder coordination, technical integration, adoption, training, and sustainment considerations.
Support change management and capability adoption by ensuring users, staffs, planners, analysts, and leadership understand how new tools, workflows, processes, and methodologies improve mission execution.
Coordinate pilot efforts, proof-of-concept activities, capability demonstrations, user-feedback sessions, after-action reviews, and continuous-improvement cycles.
Develop measures of performance, measures of effectiveness, adoption metrics, utilization indicators, and ROI inputs to assess capability value and inform prioritization decisions.
Support integration of advanced technologies, digital tools, data-management approaches, AI-enabled analytics, collaboration platforms, and knowledge-management solutions into operational workflows.
Maintain alignment between project execution, ASAT innovation priorities, PMO governance, CCMD requirements, task-level deliverables, and Apollo’s enterprise operating model.
Prepare and deliver executive-level briefings, project status updates, recommendations, decision papers, implementation plans, and lessons-learned products for Government and Amentum leadership.
Travel CONUS/OCONUS as required to support capability implementation, stakeholder engagement, project coordination, training/adoption support, and mission-partner requirements.

Required Qualifications

Must have an active Secret security clearance.
Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Program Management, Business Administration, National Security Studies, Military Studies, Information Operations, Operations Research, Organizational Development, Systems Engineering, Data Analytics, Public Administration, or a related discipline.
Minimum 11 years of experience supporting project management, program management, capability development, capability integration, operational planning, mission support, transformation, modernization, or related national-security mission areas.
Demonstrated experience managing complex projects involving multiple stakeholders, technical contributors, operational users, dependencies, risks, schedules, and deliverables.
Experience supporting military operations, Combatant Commands, Joint organizations, government mission environments, or complex DoD programs.
Strong understanding of OIE, Information Advantage, Information Forces integration, operational intelligence, campaign planning, assessment, knowledge management, digital modernization, and Joint operational environments.
Experience developing project plans, implementation roadmaps, risk registers, action trackers, decision logs, project schedules, executive briefings, or capability-development documentation.
Demonstrated ability to translate operational requirements into executable project plans, capability-integration strategies, and measurable implementation outcomes.
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams that may include planners, analysts, technologists, data specialists, training/adoption personnel, operations SMEs, assessment personnel, and leadership stakeholders.

At American Vision Partners (AVP)
, we partner with the most respected ophthalmology practices in the country and integrate best-in-class management systems, operational infrastructure, and advanced technology to provide the highest quality patient care possible. Our practices include Barnet Dulaney Perkins Eye Center, Southwestern Eye Center, Retinal Consultants of Arizona, M&M Eye Institute, Abrams Eye Institute, Southwest Eye Institute, Aiello Eye Institute, Moretsky Cassidy Vision Correction, Wellish Vision Institute, West Texas Eye Associates and Vantage Eye Center. We are focused on building the nation’s largest and most comprehensive eye care practices and currently operate more than 100 eye care centers in Arizona, New Mexico, Nevada, California and Texas – including 25 ambulatory surgical centers.

At AVP we value teamwork, providing exceptional experiences, continuous improvement, financial strength, and hard work. We are committed to providing best-in-class patient care, pioneering research and technology, and most importantly, rewarding and recognizing our employees!

Overview

The Project Manager is responsible for leading complex business, operational, technology, and acquisition integration initiatives across the organization. This role serves as a strategic bridge between Applications, IT, and business leadership, ensuring successful execution of projects that improve operational efficiency, integrate new capabilities, and support organizational growth. The Project Manager (PM) drives project governance, change management, stakeholder alignment, and adoption of new practices while delivering projects on time, within scope, and aligned to business objectives.

Responsibilities

Serve as the PM lead for strategic projects and technology initiatives, driving them from intake through implementation and closeout while ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and stakeholders.
Act as the primary liaison between Applications/IT and departmental leaders to ensure value is delivered from technology initiatives through discovery, testing, and adoption of new processes and solutions.
Collaborate as an Applications/IT partner with the Diligence & Integration team to successfully plan and execute acquisition integrations.
Manage multiple concurrent projects while effectively prioritizing competing business and technology needs.
Develop and maintain standardized processes and documentation for project execution, leveraging EPMO best practices to enhance efficiency and scalability.
Drive program integrity and stability by maintaining EPMO governance, documentation, practices, templates, policies, tools, and partnerships that improve organizational project delivery capabilities.
Work autonomously to manage the end-to-end project lifecycle, from discovery and data collection to field trials, implementation planning and deployment, ensuring smooth execution across all phases.
Lead project meetings while preparing and maintaining clear project documentation, presentations, action logs, status reports, and executive summaries.
Facilitate accountability across departments by tracking action items, monitoring commitments, and ensuring task completion.
Direct and coordinate cross-functional team resources, resolve project conflicts, and escalate obstacles and risks to leadership when necessary.
Track issues and risks while ensuring resolution through probing questions; actively identify and support teams in removing obstacles, waste, and distractions that may impede project delivery.
Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and executive leadership regarding project status, milestones, risks, issues, resource constraints, scope changes, dependencies, and key decisions.
Ensure effective organizational readiness by coordinating communication, training, and change management activities that support successful project adoption and minimize operational disruption.
Coordinate with vendors, third-party partners, and internal technical teams to support system implementations, integrations, migrations, and other technology-related initiatives.
Partner with FP&A to track project budgets, integration costs, anticipated synergies, and realization timelines.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Business Administration, Health Care

Administration, or other related field.

3+ years project management or equivalent experience
Project management experience in healthcare preferred
Project Management Professional Certification (PMP) preferred
ADKAR training preferred
Experience working with and presenting deliverables to an executive-level leadership team
IT experience preferred, with an understanding of software development process, system implementations, application integrations, infrastructure environments, and the ability to effectively partner with technical teams.
Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with a solution-oriented approach.
Attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
Thorough understanding of project management phases, techniques and tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to build collaborative relationships while working in a moderately complex and matrixed team environment.
Ability to facilitate discussions and hold team members accountable without having positional authority.
Ability to handle multiple tasks, set priorities, schedule and meet deadlines.
Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
Possess quality presentation skills and experience in presenting complex plans and designs to executive-level leadership.

Benefits & Perks

Your health, happiness and your future matters! At AVP, we offer everything from medical and dental insurance, significant eye care discounts, child care assistance, pet insurance, continuing education funds, 401(k), paid holidays, PTO, Sick Time, opportunity for growth, and much more!

Hadrian - Manufacturing the Future

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.

Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.

Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.

If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

The Role

The Project Manager is responsible for the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for key programs and products, serving as the central integrator between program, manufacturing engineering, supply chain, and operations timelines.

This position partners cross-functionally to ensure alignment between engineering schedules, supply chain lead times, and delivery commitments in a dynamic, high-mix NPI manufacturing environment.

What You'll Do

Own the IMS. Develop Integrated Master Schedules for products, programs, capabilities, and production sites. Sequence development, procurement, construction, equipment installation, and qualification activities across concurrent NPI and factory-buildout workstreams for feasible schedules.
Own updates and ensure the schedule is a trusted tool for decision-making and reliable source of valid data.
Track schedule performance against baseline, proactively identifying risk, quantifying impacts of changes, and surfacing key insights. Drive solutioning to achieve milestones and maintain delivery commitments.
Facilitate cross-functional schedule reviews and ensure stakeholder alignment on milestone dates, deliverables, and resource trade-offs. Drive accountability for on-time delivery.
Support definition of scheduling philosophy, standards, and patterns. Systematize and automate to efficiently scale scheduling.

What We’re Looking For

7+ years of experience in integrated scheduling, project management, or engineering or manufacturing planning.
Demonstrated experience developing and managing an Integrated Master Schedule.
Strong knowledge of scheduling methodologies and principles, including for estimating durations and qualifying risk.
Experience using scheduling tools (e.g. MS Project, Primavera P6, Smartsheets, etc) and building automations and connectors.
Ability to partner with stakeholders and drive accountability. Strong communicator and relationship builder.

What Will Set You Apart

Experience in development and scaling phases of aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or other complex hardware manufacturing industries.
Undeterred by ambiguity and proven delivery of meaningful outcomes.
Ability to bring structure and process to fast-paced environments while maintaining velocity
Experience supporting multi-site or multi-program production environments and/or working knowledge of SQL, Python, or similar analytics tools.

Compensation

For this role, the target salary range is $160,000-$220,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Your Opportunity

AECOM is seeking a results-driven Senior Design-Build Project Manager to join our Buildings + Places team.

In this role, you will lead the delivery of complex, high-profile projects using Design-Build and alternative delivery models, including Progressive or Modified Design-Build, Alliance, and Integrated Project Delivery. You will be embedded within high-performing, multidisciplinary teams acting as the single point of accountability for project delivery, integrating design and construction to achieve exceptional outcomes. This is a newly created position.

You will play a critical leadership role, shaping project execution, driving commercial value engineering strategies, building lasting GC and client relationships while delivering impactful infrastructure and building projects across Canada.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced Design-Build leader looking to take ownership of major projects and contribute to the continued growth of AECOM’s presence in the delivery of alternative delivery projects.

Why AECOM?

• Shape Communities:
Deliver landmark projects that define the future of our communities

• Lead with Impact:
Take ownership of complex Design-Build and alternative delivery projects and drive meaningful outcomes

• Accelerate Your Career:
Access structured leadership development, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities

• Work with Industry Leaders:
Collaborate with top-tier architects, engineers, and project leaders

• Flexible & Supportive Environment:
Competitive compensation, hybrid work model, and comprehensive benefits

• Global Impact:
Be part of a world-class team delivering complex infrastructure solutions at scale

What You Will Do

You will lead the full project lifecycle with a strong focus on integration, execution, and performance:

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead Design-Build and alternative delivery projects from early strategy through construction and close-out
Act as the single point of accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and safety outcomes
Drive project execution strategies that integrate design, construction, and stakeholder requirements

Design-Build Integration & Coordination

Partner with Design Build contractors, joint venture partners, consultants, and internal teams to ensure constructability and alignment
Lead multidisciplinary teams across architecture, engineering, and project controls
Ensure seamless integration between design development and construction execution

Project Controls & Commercial Performance

Manage project financial performance including budgeting, forecasting, fee management, and margin optimization
Oversee change management, contract administration, and commercial risk management
Monitor progress against key milestones and implement corrective actions as required
Collaborate with stakeholders, GC estimators and design managers to deliver on commercial value engineering options

Risk, Quality & Safety

Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks (technical, commercial, and delivery)
Ensure compliance with AECOM’s quality management systems and safe work practices
Lead project reviews and ensure audit-defensible documentation

Client & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary client interface, building trusted relationships and ensuring delivery excellence
Lead coordination with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), permitting bodies, and regulatory stakeholders
Facilitate effective communication across all project stakeholders

Business Development & Growth

Support capture strategies, proposals, and client engagement activities
Contribute to strengthening AECOM’s Design-Build presence across Canada
Identify opportunities for repeat work and client expansion

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related field + 8 (eight) years of experience managing multiple projects of various types and complexities for transportation, defence, institutional, and light industrial clients
Demonstrated experience delivering Design-Build or alternative delivery projects
Ability to obtain and maintain Government of Canada security clearances

Security Clearance Requirements

Must hold or be eligible to obtain:

 o Reliability Status (minimum)

 o Secret Clearance (required for many federal projects)
Ability to comply with project-specific security protocols, including controlled site access and information handling requirements

Preferred Qualifications

Professional designation (P.Eng. or Architect)
15+ years of progressive project management experience delivering building or infrastructure projects
PMP certification; DBIA certification or equivalent is an asset
Strong commercial acumen with experience managing project financials, contracts, and change management
Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams in complex project environments
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Technical Skills

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (including Excel for financial tracking and reporting)
Experience with project scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent)
Familiarity with project delivery and document control platforms (e.g., SharePoint, BIM 360, Aconex)
Working knowledge of project controls systems, reporting tools, and data-driven performance tracking

Additional Information

Relocation is not available for this position.
Sponsorship for Canadian employment authorization is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

Offered rate of compensation will be based on individual education, qualifications, experience, and work location. The range for this position is $170000 to $220000.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Strategic Customer Implementations
jobs.description:
Maven AGI is an enterprise AI platform on a mission to unleash business artificial general intelligence (AGI), starting with customer service. Founded in July 2023 by executives from HubSpot, Google and Stripe, Maven builds conversational AI agents capable of delivering accurate, autonomous support that delights customers at scale.

Our platform unifies fragmented systems, integrates knowledge and personalization sources, and enables intelligent actions - all without costly system changes. We’re laying the foundation for a future where our technology handles complex tasks, allowing people to focus on what they do best: creative problem-solving, relationship building, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

We’ve started by reimagining the enterprise customer experience with a support use case. We believe that today’s support experience is broken: slow and painful for customers, and expensive and human capital intensive for companies.

We are building Maven to deliver better, cheaper support, for both end users and agents. With recent advancements in Generative AI, it is now possible to deliver delightful customer experiences at a fraction of today’s cost.

Team

Maven has assembled a world-class team of Engineers from Google, Meta, Amazon, and Stripe, and is supported by executives & Advisors from OpenAI, Google, HubSpot, and Stripe.

About The Role

This role is the operational and technical backbone of Maven's most complex, highest-stakes customer implementations. It exists because the work requires someone who is simultaneously a builder, a tracker, and a communicator who won't let things fall through the cracks.

What You'll Do

Owns execution end-to-end on strategic pilots. Not coordination, ownership. You'll track every open item across customer-facing trackers and internal tools (Linear, ClickUp, Notion), know what's blocked, know who needs to be chased down, and drive things to resolution without being asked. Tickets are clean, unambiguous, and mapped correctly. You don't wait for someone to flag a gap, you catch it first.
Understands the platform deeply enough to be useful, not just present. You know Maven's platform and how it interacts with external systems. You can debug a broken integration, read an API error and know where the problem lives, recognize when an intelligent field evaluation is causing a downstream cascade, and describe what's wrong clearly enough that an engineer can fix it immediately. You won't need hand-holding on the technical environment.
Translates between customer and engineering. You join working sessions with customers and come out with crisp, actionable documentation. You write the kind of meeting notes and tickets that engineers want to work from. You understand what customers are trying to accomplish, can spot when a request is misframed, and know when to push back internally versus when to escalate.
Tests relentlessly before go-live. You run test suites, document what broke and why, validate fixes, and track edge cases with rigor.
Runs the operational rhythm. Daily standups, go-live checklists, readiness reviews, metrics readouts — you own the structure that keeps a complex multi-team pilot from going sideways. You're the person who notices when the ClickUp tracker hasn't been updated and fixes it before the Monday client session, not after.

Who You Are

Organized to the point of being vocal about it.
Technically credible without being an engineer.
Comfortable sitting in rooms with enterprise stakeholders and with product engineers on the same day.
Does not need external motivation to chase someone down when something is stuck.
Gets things done.

What We Offer

High Impact in cutting-edge field: Be at the vanguard of AI innovation.
Compensation Package: Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful equity stakes.
Inclusive Culture: A diverse and welcoming work environment where everyone’s voice is heard.

What unites us are our values and the passion we share to live by them:

Do right for our customers
We are data-driven
Be entrepreneurial
Strive to be better, together

Position:
Project Manager (PMP) – Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ERP Implementation
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of a multi-entity ERP integration and change management program. This role is responsible for consolidating multiple operating businesses onto a single ERP platform ( Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central with an industry-specific layer/ Integrator ), while driving the people-side of change across finance, operations, sales, procurement, and warehouse teams.
The successful candidate will bring proven experience running Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ERP implementations or migrations that span multiple legal entities, business units, and legacy systems, and will thrive in a fast-paced merger and integration environment.
Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery
•
Own the full project lifecycle — initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closure — across all workstreams (Finance, Inventory/Master Data, Sales, Procurement, Warehouse, Reporting).
•
Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, RAID log, budget, and status dashboards.
•
Manage cross-functional resources, external implementation partners, and vendors to hit milestones on time and on budget.
•
Facilitate steering committee, sponsor, and working group meetings — including agendas, minutes, and follow-ups.

ERP & Systems Expertise
•
Lead requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, and business process design across multiple entities.
•
Coordinate master data strategy (item, customer, vendor, GL, UOM) and standardization across businesses.
•
Oversee data migration, cutover planning, UAT, hypercare, and go-live activities.
•
Partner with IT and the implementation vendor on configuration, integrations, and reporting.

Multi-Business Integration
•
Align processes and policies across multiple acquired or sister companies, balancing standardization with local business needs.
•
Manage stakeholder relationships across finance, operations, sales, warehouse, and executive leadership at each site.
•
Support synergy tracking, site transitions, and harmonization of workflows post-merger.

Change Management & Governance
•
Build and execute the change management plan — stakeholder analysis, communication plan, training strategy, and adoption metrics.
•
Develop governance frameworks, RACI charts, one-pagers, and SOPs to embed sustainable practices.
•
Lead training, super-user programs, and knowledge transfer to end users.
•
Champion a culture of process discipline, data governance, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Required
•
5–8+ years of Project Management experience, with at least 2 full-cycle ERP implementations or migrations delivered. Prefereably Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central,
•
Demonstrated experience managing ERP projects across multiple business entities, sites, or acquired companies.
•
Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, NetSuite, SAP, or comparable mid-market ERP. Industry-specific layers (e.g., food/seafood, distribution) an asset.
•
Strong understanding of core business processes: Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Inventory & Warehouse, Finance/GL, Master Data Management.
•
Proven ability to lead change management initiatives — communications, training, adoption, and stakeholder engagement.
•
Advanced skills in MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, Teams/SharePoint.
•
PMP, Prince2, or equivalent certification preferred; Prosci / CCMP change certification is a strong asset.

jobs.title: Technical Implementation Manager, Lob Logistics
jobs.description:
Lob was founded in 2013 by technical co-founders with a vision to connect the world one mailbox at a time. Today, we're transforming the way businesses use direct mail and bringing the power of technology to a traditionally manual channel.

Our modern logistics and fulfillment engine helps businesses to build and scale high-quality, personalized direct mail programs without the operational burden. As we grow to meet the evolving needs of our customers and expand our product offerings, we’re building a team to shape the future of direct mail.

Technical Implementation Manager, Lob Logistics

About The Role

Lob Logistics is looking for a Technical Implementation Manager to lead the technical onboarding and integration of new customers and logistics partners.

You will own customer integrations from verbal commitment through launch and the first 30 days in production. You will work directly with customer technical, operational, and postal teams to understand their workflows, design the integration, configure APIs and customer profiles, troubleshoot issues, coordinate postal requirements, and ensure the solution works successfully in production.

Lob Logistics is intentionally built around a white-glove customer experience
. Our customers are often integrating complex technology, production, postal, and logistics workflows, and we believe the best implementations require more than handing customers documentation and asking them to integrate themselves. The Technical Implementation Manager will work closely with customers throughout the process, including traveling onsite when appropriate for project scoping, technical working sessions, testing, and finalizing integrations.

This is a hands-on technical role. You should be comfortable working with APIs, data, developer tools, and AI coding tools such as Claude Code. We are looking for someone who can solve technical problems directly rather than simply coordinate work between customers and Engineering.

The right person will be equally comfortable sitting with a customer’s engineering team to design an integration, troubleshooting an API or data issue, working with a commingling partner on postal requirements, and walking a customer through the final steps required to successfully launch.

What You’ll Do

Own Customer Implementations

Own new Lob Logistics customer implementations from verbal commitment through the first 30 days in production.
Lead technical discovery and scoping with customers, including understanding their existing systems, mail workflows, data requirements, production needs, postage strategy, billing and integration architecture.
Travel to customer locations as appropriate to lead project scoping, technical working sessions, implementation planning, testing, and final integration activities. This role will have regular, consistent travel.
Develop and document the technical implementation plan and define requirements, dependencies, testing criteria, and launch readiness.
Configure customer profiles and integrations across Lob Logistics systems working with commingle partners on integrations.
Own testing, UAT, go-live, and the first 30 days of production stabilization before transitioning the customer to the long-term account owner.
Maintain a high-touch, white-glove approach throughout implementation, ensuring customers have a clear technical owner who remains accountable from initial scoping through a successful production launch.

Build & Troubleshoot Integrations

Work directly with customers to integrate with Lob Logistics through our APIs or customer portal.
Understand and troubleshoot API requests, JSON payloads, authentication, webhooks, data mappings, and integration errors.
Use Claude Code and other development tools to navigate code, investigate issues, build scripts and utilities, create working examples, and accelerate customer integrations.
Identify whether technical issues originate with the customer, Lob, a partner, data, configuration, or the underlying integration and drive them to resolution.
Look for opportunities to automate repetitive implementation work and build tools that make future integrations faster and more reliable.

Scope Technical Solutions

Determine when customer requirements can be solved through configuration or existing capabilities and when custom development is required.
Scope custom technical requirements and partner with Product and Engineering on solutions requiring platform changes.
Provide clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical context to Engineering.
Partner with the implementation project manager to ensure technical requirements, dependencies, risks, and timelines are reflected in the broader implementation plan.

Own Postal & Partner Setup

Coordinate the technical and operational requirements necessary to successfully move customer mail through Lob Logistics.
Ensure customer implementations meet USPS and commingling requirements, including PAFs, postal promotions, customer profiles, mail owner and mail service provider configurations, and other applicable requirements.
Work directly with Lob’s commingling partners on new customer setup and ensure all technical, operational, and postal requirements are completed before launch.
Partner with internal postal subject matter experts when deeper expertise is required while maintaining ownership of the overall implementation.
Ensure the customer’s technical integration works across the entire physical mail workflow, not simply at the point of API acceptance.

What We’re Looking For

5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, technical consulting, implementation strategy, solutions architecture, customer success, or a similar customer-facing role working with technology and systems.
Strong understanding of how business systems, applications, and data integrations work together, with familiarity with concepts such as APIs, data flows, authentication, and system integrations.
Experience in direct mail, print manufacturing, logistics, fulfillment, shipping, payments, EDI, or another environment where software connects to complex physical operations.
Understanding of USPS mail preparation, Intelligent Mail barcodes, PostalOne!, Mail.dat/Mail.XML, PAF requirements, postal promotions, commingling, drop shipping, or destination entry.
Experience working with customers to understand their existing technology landscape, identify requirements, and recommend practical solution approaches.
Ability to translate ambiguous customer needs and business processes into clear technical requirements, solution designs, and implementation plans.
Comfortable partnering with customer engineers, IT teams, and internal technical resources to guide integrations and troubleshoot implementation challenges.
Ability to identify potential technical risks, dependencies, and gaps and coordinate with the appropriate engineering or technical teams to resolve them.
Familiarity with modern technical tools and AI-assisted development tools is a plus, with the ability to use them to investigate questions, validate approaches, and collaborate effectively with technical teams.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate between technical, operational, and business audiences.
Ability to lead technical discovery and solution conversations while maintaining a strong understanding of the customer's business goals and desired outcomes.
Ability to manage multiple complex implementations while maintaining clear ownership and attention to detail.
A strong customer orientation and willingness to do what is necessary to deliver a high-touch, white-glove implementation experience.
A bias toward solving problems directly rather than simply escalating them.
Willingness and ability to travel to customer and partner locations for project scoping, technical working sessions, integration testing, and launch support.

What Success Looks Like

You become the clear technical owner for every implementation assigned to you.
Customers move from verbal commitment to production quickly and predictably.
Customers feel like Lob is working alongside them throughout the implementation rather than handing them an integration and waiting for it to be completed.
Technical, postal, and operational requirements are identified early rather than becoming launch-day surprises.
Customers successfully operate in production during their first 30 days and transition cleanly to their long-term account owner.
Routine integration challenges are solved by the Technical Implementation team without unnecessary dependency on Engineering.
Customer and partner integrations become more standardized, automated, and repeatable over time.
You develop trusted relationships with customer technical and operational teams because you understand both their systems and how their mail physically moves through the Lob Logistics network.
Most importantly, you don’t just manage implementations. You make them happen.

Compensation Information

The compensation for this role consists of a base salary + additional RSUs.

Annual Base Salary: $142,500 - $162,500

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

WPP is undertaking a significant multi-year transformation to simplify and modernise its technology landscape, including the consolidation of multiple CRM platforms into a single, globally governed Microsoft Dynamics CRM solution.

This transformation is central to WPP's strategic objectives, enabling the organisation to:

Improve client, opportunity, and pipeline visibility across the business
Enhance data quality, governance, and reporting capabilities
Enable AI-powered and data-driven commercial decision-making
Reduce technology complexity, duplication, and operational costs across agencies

The Global CRM Programme is a high-profile, business-critical initiative spanning multiple workstreams, including business process design, functional requirements, technology delivery, data migration, systems integration, and organisational change management. To support its successful delivery, we are seeking an experienced Global CRM Project Manager to lead the coordination and execution of programme activities across a complex stakeholder landscape.

The Role

The Global CRM Project Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end coordination of multiple interdependent workstreams, ensuring integrated planning, effective dependency management, and alignment with programme objectives.

What you'll be doing:

Develop and maintain integrated project plans across business, functional, technology, data, and change workstreams, ensuring delivery remains aligned to programme priorities, milestones, and strategic objectives.
Coordinate cross-functional dependencies, fostering collaboration between business process, functional design, technology, data, integration, and change teams to ensure seamless execution.
Monitor delivery progress against agreed plans, proactively identifying, managing, and escalating risks, issues, dependencies, and potential roadblocks.
Ensure decisions made through programme governance forums—including the Business Transformation SteerCo, CRM Design Authority, and Technology Delivery Programme Board—are translated into clear actions, accountabilities, and measurable outcomes.
Support the development and delivery of programme communications, ensuring consistent messaging and stakeholder engagement across global, regional, agency, and market teams.
Coordinate training and business readiness activities, helping to prepare users and stakeholders for rollout phases while ensuring alignment between global standards and local market requirements.
Support the definition, baselining, and tracking of programme benefits, partnering with business and delivery teams to ensure measurable value is realised throughout the programme lifecycle.
Maintain high-quality project management artefacts, including integrated plans, RAID logs, status reports, governance packs, and decision registers.
Deliver clear, concise, and insightful reporting to senior stakeholders, providing transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, and areas requiring attention or intervention.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of programme governance, delivery frameworks, tools, and ways of working to enhance programme effectiveness and execution excellence.

This is a highly visible role that will sit at the centre of a complex global transformation programme, providing the structure, coordination, and leadership required to drive successful delivery and long-term adoption of WPP's global CRM strategy.

What you'll need:

Demonstrated experience delivering complex technology, digital, or business transformation programmes in a Project Manager or similar delivery leadership role.
Experience working across both business and technology workstreams, ideally within CRM, customer platforms, or enterprise SaaS environments.
Strong project management capabilities, including planning, dependency management, risk and issue management, governance, and stakeholder coordination.
Experience supporting business readiness activities, including communications, training coordination, change adoption, and benefits realisation.
Ability to operate effectively within complex, matrixed, or multi-business environments, balancing competing priorities and diverse stakeholder needs.
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across business, technical, and leadership teams.
Excellent organisational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, concise updates for a range of audiences.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving clarity, and maintaining momentum within a fast-paced and evolving programme environment.
Experience partnering with system integrators, consulting organisations, or external delivery partners would be advantageous.

Who you are:

You're open :
We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic :
We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary:
we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

– We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity
– We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. Job Description And Duties

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to contribute to the safety, security and well-being of the workplace? Do you have a passion for project management and thrive in an environment that allows you to travel to different offices throughout California? If so, the Department of Industrial Relations’ (DIR) Safety and Security team is looking for you! As a DIR Safety and Security Analyst, you will help lead and facilitate the Department's Emergency Preparedness and Security efforts for over 3000 employees across 40+ office locations statewide.

The Safety and Security Unit is responsible for the safety of all buildings, working with local staff, management, property managers and partners in law enforcement, the Office of Emergency Services, CalFire, and other local agencies. In collaboration with other members of the Safety and Security Unit, this role is responsible for coordinating emergency preparedness drills, exercises, evacuations, and developing, implementing, and monitoring office emergency preparedness policies and security procedures.

In this role, the incumbent will coordinate with DIR and building staff in the event of an emergency or natural disaster by working with internal and external subject matter experts to maximize the safety and security of people and property. jobs.title: Business Analyst – FEC Screening Systems (Sanction Detection)
jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Sopra Steria biedt op maat gemaakte end-to-end corporate technology en software solutions aan die organisaties helpen gedurfde keuzes te maken en resultaten te boeken. En met succes! Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen behoren we tot de top van de Europese digital solutions leveranciers. Succesvolle organisaties in Europa vertrouwen op onze technologie omdat we blijven streven naar innovatie, samenwerking en zakelijke ontwikkeling.

The world is how we shape it.

Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Stap in de cruciale wereld van Know Your Customer (KYC) en het bestrijden van financiële criminaliteit (FEC) bij banken en financiële instellingen. Sopra Steria staat aan de frontlinie van het beschermen van het financiële systeem met geavanceerde, data-gedreven Sanction Screening-technologieën. Dit proces detecteert transacties waarbij personen of organisaties betrokken zijn die mogelijk risico’s vormen op het gebied van sancties, terrorismefinanciering of witwassen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Business Analyst speel je een sleutelrol in het vormgeven, testen en afstemmen van onze sanctie screening systemen en -modellen op het beleid, de risicostandaarden en compliance procedures van de klant. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de volledige levenscyclus van jouw features – van het definiëren van de requirements en begeleiden van de implementatie tot het monitoren van de prestaties en rapporteren van de resultaten. Je bent zowel een strategische denker als een hands-on analist, in staat om complexe zakelijke behoeften te vertalen naar duidelijke en uitvoerbare taken voor jouw squad.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden/taken zijn:

Specificeren van zakelijke en technische vereisten via interviews, workshops, demo’s en samenwerking
Definiëren van duidelijke en testbare acceptatiecriteria voor features en epics
Prioriteren en onderscheid maken tussen wereldwijde ‘must-haves’ en ‘nice-to-haves’ om de integriteit van wereldwijde standaarden te waarborgen
Analyseren en beoordelen van sanctie screening algoritmen, regels en drempels, en verbeteringen aanbevelen
Nauw samenwerken met Product Owners om backlog refinement en squadprioriteiten af te stemmen
Technische concepten en oplossingen helder communiceren naar internationale stakeholders
Zorgen dat alle oplossingen voldoen aan interne beleidslijnen, standaarden en regelgeving
Uitvoeren van data-analyse en mapping; oplossingen voorstellen voor datakwaliteitsproblemen
Stimuleren van een feedbackcultuur en een proactieve, oplossingsgerichte houding onderhouden

Functie-eisen

Wij zijn op zoek naar gepassioneerde collega’s die graag de grenzen verleggen op het gebied van digitale transformatie en technologieconsultancy. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen in een constructieve, samenwerkende teamomgeving, waarbij je werkt aan impactvolle projecten die verandering teweegbrengen voor onze klanten. Als je gedijt op uitdagingen en (de meeste van) de onderstaande kwalificaties bezit, kijken we uit naar je sollicitatie!

Type dienstverband: Hybride

Locatie: Nieuwegein

Aantal uren: 32-40 uur werkweek

Contractduur: Eén jaar, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

Opleiding: Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding afgerond

Talen: Nederlands (vereist)

We zoeken iemand met de volgende vaardigheden:

Minimaal 2,5 jaar relevante werkervaring als business analyst, bij voorkeur in de financiële sector
Ervaring met Sanction Screening of bredere FEC-domeinen is zeer gewenst (maar geen must)
Bekendheid met risico- en compliance-architectuur, inclusief tools zoals Inform RiskShield, Python, Databricks
Affiniteit met data analyse: in staat om data lineage analyses, kwaliteitsbeoordelingen en privacy reviews uit te voeren
Ervaring met modeltesten, risicostandaarden en rapportages aan toezichthouders
Vaardigheid om samen te werken met diverse stakeholders zoals Compliance, IT en Business Operations
Sterk functioneel inzicht in enterprise IT-landschappen
Ervaring met Agile, Scrum, DevOps, Lean of SAFe methodologieën

Daarnaast breng je de volgende persoonlijke vaardigheden mee:

Sterk analytisch denkvermogen en probleemoplossend vermogen
In staat om zowel strategisch als gedetailleerd te werken
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, met het vermogen om technische en niet-technische stakeholders te betrekken
Hoog niveau van documentatie- en rapportagevaardigheden – nauwkeurig, onderbouwd en audit-ready
Zelfstandig en georganiseerd, met het vermogen om meerdere initiatieven tegelijk te managen

Aanvullende informatie

Je zal deel uitmaken van een grote naam in de tech wereld die bekend is om consulting, digitale diensten en softwareontwikkeling. Je begeeft je tussen high-level professionals die durven in te zetten om hoge resultaten te behalen. Daarnaast maak je ook deel uit van onze Data area.

Bij Sopra Steria – Financial Economic Crime (FEC) voorzien we banken en financiële instellingen van digitale tools om risico’s te beheren, klanten te beschermen en de impact van financiële economische criminaliteit te beperken. Als poortwachters van het financiële systeem spelen banken een cruciale rol in de bescherming van onze economie tegen criminele inmenging. Daardoor worden financiële instellingen onderworpen aan steeds strengere regelgeving en toezicht. Tegelijkertijd maken wereldwijde economische instabiliteit en steeds geavanceerdere, technologiegedreven financiële criminaliteit het werk van banken steeds moeilijker.

Enkele cijfers: Naar schatting wordt jaarlijks 16 miljard euro aan crimineel geld witgewassen in Nederland. Minder dan 1% van de criminele geldstromen die via het mondiale banksysteem gaan, wordt daadwerkelijk gestopt. Daarom moeten banken hun aanpak radicaal veranderen in de strijd tegen FEC. Gelukkig zijn er tactische veranderingen die banken snel kunnen doorvoeren om het effect van financiële economische criminaliteit te verminderen.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Een vast contract en een salaris tussen de €3.000,- en €6.000,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). De exacte inschaling hangt af van jouw ervaring en de rol;
Vakantiegeld van 8%;
Sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van gezellige borrels tot sportieve of inhoudelijke uitjes;
Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via trainingen, kennisdelingssessies en inspirerende (netwerk)events;
Hybride werken: thuis of op kantoor, afhankelijk van wat jij nodig hebt;
Een royaal mobiliteitsbudget, in de vorm van een leaseregeling van €892,- met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto met NS Business Card of leasefiets of een alternatief vervoersregeling van €1.007,- net wat het beste bij jouw manier van reizen past;
Winstdeling van 8% on target;
27 betaalde vakantiedagen
Mogelijkheid om op fiscaal vriendelijke manier studieschuld af te lossen, een fiets, zonnepanelen of sportabonnementen aan te schaffen (Cafetaria-systeem) of andere personeelskortingen te verkrijgen;
Een internetvergoeding en thuiswerkvergoeding waarbij wij jou faciliteiten bieden voor de uitrusting van jouw eigen thuiskantoor;
Een flexibele pensioenregeling, waaraan jij, op maat en passend bij jou, bijdragen kunt toevoegen.

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

jobs.title: All-Source Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Number: R0247244

All-Source Intelligence Analyst

The Opportunity:

Do you find yourself constantly looking for more and better information? Do you want a job where you can use your knowledge and research skills to improve national security? Never has the role of an all-source analyst been so meaningful. More connected devices, larger storage capacity, and faster connections have resulted in an explosion of available information. The problem facing the intelligence community is no longer how to get more data, it’s understanding how to turn the data they have into answers. That’s where you come in. With critical thinking and flexibility, you quickly seek out accurate data sources, sift through the raw data, and turn it into valuable intelligence. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to protect our national security and inform our defense policymakers.

As an All-Source Intelligence Analyst on our team, you’ll explore new data sources, create effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources to help your client understand their mission and operational landscape. You’ll validate information and apply client tradecraft as you build assessments for DoD customers. This is a chance to grow your expertise and develop new skills in strategic all-source regional analysis to inform DoD customers and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools. Join us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters and nation's leaders.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

2+ years of experience with research and analysis
Experience with the CENTCOM AOR
Experience with ICD 203 tradecraft standards
Knowledge of the DoD, wider IC, and Combatant Command environments
Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
HS diploma or GED and 6+ years of experience with all-source analysis, Associate's degree and 4+ years of experience with all-source analysis, or Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of experience with all-source analysis

Nice If You Have:

4+ years of experience as a strategic all-source intelligence analyst
Experience with data analytics, analysis, and visualization
Knowledge of the intelligence cycle
Possession of excellent interpersonal skills
Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills, including briefing and a willingness to learn
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance is required.

Summary

Provide lessons learned analyses and liaison support at designated Marine Corps commands in support of the Marine Corps Lessons Learned Program (MCLLP).

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Provide Lessons Learned Program Support
Implement and maintain lessons learned processes at each designated place of performance in adherence with MCO 3504.1, the MCCLP
Review and submit lessons learned materials with proper classification and/or Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) markings prior to submission to MCCLL SharePoint/Joint Lessons Learned Information system (JLLIS)
Maintain MCCLL SharePoint/JLLIS lessons learned web page content for topics within the cognizant of their designated command
Submit weekly situational reports
Provide Lessons Learned Collection and Analysis Support
Develop/implement the MCCLL annual lessons learned collection campaign plan
Prepare and submit lessons learned collection topics associated with designated Command, based on the analysis of lessons learned requirements
Prepare the mid-year review of the annual lessons learned collection campaign plan to revalidate existing topics, and solicit emerging topics as required
Prepare briefings for senior military and government officials on collection campaign topics
Develop and submit lessons learned collection proposals, collection plans and collection debriefs, per the annual collection campaign plan. Perform lessons learned collection efforts by conducting lessons learned interviews of commanders and staff, as approved in the collection plan, topic within the following prescribed parameters: 10 Focus areas per collection, 20 Interviewees per collection, 20 questions per interviewee, and 45 minutes per interviewee, during a 14-calendar day period
Utilize the MCCLL SharePoint Battle board to capture and document all aspects of the planning and execution of the annual lessons learned campaign plan
Provide Event Support
Prepare responses for lessons learned requests for information (RFI) for the planning and execution of operations, deployments, exercises, and experiments
Prepare units for exercises and operations by providing applicable lessons learned documentation from previous operations, exercises, deployments, and experiments

Attend planning conferences, work group sessions, meetings and other seminars required to support the lessons learned planning aspects of operations, deployments, exercises, and experiments
Assist in the post event hot wash reviews

submission requirements for completed events for the prior 6 months and forecast AAR submissions going forward 6 months.

Demonstrated experience in military operational planning
Ability to interact and effectively communicate with Marine Corps senior uniformed officers and senior executives
Excellent oral and written communications skills; writing ability commensurate with article submission to military publications; demonstrated expertise in military presentation

First Eagle Investments is an independent, privately owned investment management firm headquartered in New York with approximately $217 billion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026. The firm’s investment capabilities include equity, fixed income, alternative credit and multi-asset strategies. For more information, please visit www.firsteagle.com.

Self-starting, entrepreneurial and resourceful

jobs.title: Risk Operations Analyst - SSO
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Strategic Supportability Operations (SSO) sits within Risk Operations and User Policy Operations. Our team is focused on protecting and advancing Stripe's business, brand, and mission by deploying industry-leading supportability solutions that instill user and partner trust in Stripe, while enabling progressive and sustainable business growth. Unlike other Risk Operations teams, SSO handles the most complex, high-stakes, and ambiguous user business cases—ones that require deep investigation, custom risk analysis, and creative problem-solving at the intersection of user experience, compliance, financial partner requirements, and Stripe's growth ambitions.

What you'll do

As a Risk Operations Analyst on the Strategic Supportability Operations team, you will investigate and assess complex, gray-area user business cases that require deep risk judgment and tailored solutions. You will go beyond standard procedures to understand the full risk profile of users, develop custom recommendations, and collaborate across internal teams to drive cohesive, well-reasoned decisions. You will also play a key role in identifying patterns across individual cases to improve our processes, policies, and detection systems at scale—bridging tactical casework with strategic, systemic impact across Risk Operations.

Responsibilities

Investigate complex, high-risk, and gray-area user business cases, applying deep risk knowledge to make sound, non-binary judgments.
Navigate ambiguity confidently—develop custom, evidence-based solutions where standard frameworks do not fully apply.
Identify and escalate systemic trends across cases, proposing scalable solutions to cross-functional stakeholders.
Collaborate across Risk Operations, User Support, Risk Partnerships, Legal, Compliance, and Product to develop holistic risk mitigation strategies.
Engage directly with users—in both positive and sensitive conversations—always maintaining a Users First mindset while balancing regulatory and financial partner requirements.
Communicate complex risk findings clearly to internal partners, financial partners, and Stripe leadership.
Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of SSO processes, decision frameworks, and tooling.
Build and maintain documentation, procedures, and playbooks to support team scalability and knowledge management.
Identify gaps in current systems, policies, and strategies, and recommend enhancements through a collaborative approach with stakeholders.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, fraud, financial operations, or a closely related field in a fast-moving environment.
Demonstrated ability to navigate gray-area and non-binary decision-making in complex risk environments.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize multiple data sources into a coherent risk narrative.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally on complex problems and driving alignment across teams with competing priorities.
Ability to engage directly with users—including in difficult or sensitive conversations—with empathy, clarity, and professionalism.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex risk findings to varied audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and fast-paced, constantly evolving environments.
Track record of identifying systemic problems from individual case patterns and driving process improvements.
Deep empathy for entrepreneurs and businesses, and genuine motivation to solve problems that empower them.
The ability and desire to challenge the status quo as a creative thinker who considers problems from a user perspective while being pragmatic and solutions-oriented.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with compliance or financial partnership relationship management.
Experience with risk assessment and mitigation strategies in a fintech or payments environment.
Working knowledge of data analysis and AI tools to quantify risk and inform decisions.
Background in regulatory compliance within financial services.
Experience developing scalable operational frameworks or playbooks in ambiguous, high-stakes environments.
Knowledge of payment processing systems and associated risks.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is SGD 110,400 - SGD 165,600. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.description:
Company Overview

The Center for International Private Enterprise (CIPE) strengthens democracy around the world through private enterprise and market-oriented reform. CIPE is one of the four core institutes of the National Endowment for Democracy and is an affiliate of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce. Since 1983, CIPE has worked with business leaders, policymakers, and civil society to build the institutions vital to a democratic society. CIPE’s key program areas include Enterprise Ecosystems, Democratic Governance, Business Advocacy, Women’s Economic Empowerment, Anti-Corruption & Ethics, and Trade.

Position:
Senior Program Manager
Reports to:
Regional Hub Director, Europe and Eurasia
Period of Performance:
September 2026 – March 31st 2027

Scope:
CIPE is seeking a full-time, exempt position based in Washington, D.C. for a Senior Program Manager for Central Asia. This position is responsible for the development and implementation of CIPE’s strategic focus on democratic governance through private sector collective action initiatives to improve business participation, economic freedom, and opportunity across the region by developing regional and country strategies, communications strategies, project implementation, and support grants to local business organizations, think tanks, and chambers of commerce. The position will manage CIPE’s U.S. Department of State-funded Central Asia Migration Entrepreneurship Program (CAMEP) and UK FCDO-funded “Equipping Central Asian Business to Navigate Global Economic Security Issues – Phase II” project.

Responsibilities:

Contribute to the development and implementation of strategy for accomplishing CIPE’s objectives on improving democratic governance and advancing market reforms in region.
Design, implement, and manage a portfolio of projects and grants for the assigned region, supportive of CIPE’s overall goals and strategies for target countries. Project responsibilities have the following dimensions:
Develop project concept papers, proposals, reports, and correspondence.
Act as CIPE’s representative to promote democratic market-oriented institutional reforms in region including developing and implementing training programs, public speaking at events, and facilitating meetings with partners, potential partners, and other stakeholders.
Lead and contribute to business development efforts by drafting full proposals narratives, technical sections of proposal narratives, budget inputs, or other thematic documents.
Analyze, research, and be familiar with the region’s political and economic landscape, identifying opportunities for CIPE programs and partners.
Identify potential partner organizations and beneficiaries in country and collaborate to design effective democratic and economic-reform programs.
Analyze both solicited and unsolicited project proposals in the context of the regional socio-political context, CIPE strategy, grant guidelines, and criteria.
Collaborate with partners to refine project proposals, monitoring and evaluation plans, and project budgets.
Implement, monitor, and manage all project activities, in collaboration with local partner organizations and CIPE team members.
Establish and maintain regular communication with project partners and other stakeholders.
Maintain correspondence and operational records regarding CIPE-funded programs in the assigned portfolio.
Monitor grantees, contractors, and consultants’ performance to ensure full compliance with objectives, financial and reporting requirements, and evaluation plans.
Evaluate projects through on-site visits, file reviews, and coordination with independent evaluators where appropriate.
Develop project reports, summaries, and assessments.
Provide oversight of CIPE country representatives across the assigned portfolio, includes supervision and leadership on all project activities, budgets, and expenditures.
Responsible for the financial management and stewardship of funds, including monitoring project spending, projecting future expenses, approving expenditures, and developing accurate budget for new projects. May include financial and operational management of a field office.
Establish and maintain relationships with other donor organizations to identify linkages with CIPE strategies, monitor trends, and assess new funding opportunities. Work with the U.S. State Department, UK FCDO, and other assistance programs to develop joint projects, grants and/or contracts to further democratic and economic reform initiatives.
Establish technical expertise, translating program experiences into lessons learned for internal and external stakeholders. Facilitate staff building technical expertise in thematic areas of work through leading staff training, developing internal resources, and/or leading staff working groups.
